page.overview:
What is Big Top Showroom?

The Big Top Showroom, also known as Showroom 2, is a carnival-style hub area. This is where Big Top is located. Around the showroom are three minigames: The Space Gallery (Blast Off), The Shooting Gallery (Fire Away), and the Ball Toss (Smack a Clown).

There is also a Prize Wheel here. Each time the player completes a minigame, the power in the room goes out and Big Top begins to slowly search the room, scanning a crowd of mannequins. Being spotted results in a game over.

To regain power, the player must complete a puzzle in the main showroom lobby. If not done in time or failed, Big Top will jumpscare the player, resulting in a game over. " The player can then head upstairs and collect the "Grand Prize" collectible.

entity.description:
The Big Top Showroom, also known as Showroom 2, is a carnival-style hub area. This is where Big Top is located. Around the showroom are three minigames: The Space Gallery (Blast Off), The Shooting Gallery (Fire Away), and the Ball Toss (Smack a Clown). There is also a Prize Wheel here.

Each time the player completes a minigame, the power in the room goes out and Big Top begins to slowly search the room, scanning a crowd of mannequins. Being spotted results in a game over.

To regain power, the player must complete a puzzle in the main showroom lobby. If not done in time or failed, Big Top will jumpscare the player, resulting in a game over.

Upon completing all three minigames, spinning the Prize Wheel will result in the wheel landing on "Grand Prize." The player can then head upstairs and collect the "Grand Prize" collectible.
